name: routeai
description: Claude routes small, well-scoped coding tasks to the AIs you already have: the Ollama machines on your network and OpenAI-compatible providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, ...). Free capacity before paid, per-node quotas and budgets, parallel batches, a work queue that keeps going while Claude is paused, and a self-learning benchmark. Claude keeps the governance, you spend fewer tokens.
